'''Blue Ten''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the tenth member of Blue Squadron. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Blue Ten.

==History==
Blue Ten was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tetengo Noor]] when he flew with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Edor Crespin]]'s [[Blue Squadron (New Republic)|Blue Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Folor]], in which the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing interceptor]] pilot flew wing-to-wing with squadronmate [[Dorset Konnair]], [[Blue Nine/Legends|Blue Nine]], in a ploy to impersonate the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="XWWS" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars:'' Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], a member of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|squadron]], identified as Blue Squadron, uses the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] Blue Ten.<ref name="ANHn">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]</ref> However, in the film, Skywalker's squadron is Red Squadron.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
